name: The First Encounter
message:
As you sleep, you find yourself dreaming of a vast, blue skyscape that stretches in all directions around you.  Four strange figures, shrouded in either red or black float in a slow circle around, humming in a way that vibrates your very being.  Despite this, you feel safe.  At peace.

When you wake up, you find in your hand a single gold coin, warm to the touch.

It makes you really feel like gambling.

name: The Second Encounter
message:
In your sleep, you discover that you've returned to the endless sky of the last dream.  The air feels heavier this time.  As though the figures expect something from you, though you cannot begin to understand what.

Until the very world around you begins to flicker and warp.Images of a casino, lost to time somewhere deep in the forest. Bereft of the flashing lights and sounds of chips and coins raining down that such a holy place deserved. Alone.  Abandoned.

Then... darkness... a figure.  Dressed like a High Priest yet... different.  Sinister.  Malevolent.

-Who is this asshole?-

And then you awake.  And in your hand, your lucky coin grows warm.

It's time to gamble.

Huh?  What's this?  Right as you push up from the ground a flyer hits your face.  It's an ad for a... bath house?
